column1: # Half-remembered lines, then the refs that count as the right answer, joined by "|". Ranking was tuned against
# this set. Written October 14, 2026, before any tuning.
to be or not
wherefor art thou romeo
a rose by any other name would smell as sweet
all the worlds a stage
now is the winter of our discontent
friends romans countrymen lend me your ears
double double toil and trouble
out damned spot
is this a dagger i see before me
shal i compare thee to a summers day
the course of true love never runs smooth
if music is the food of love play on
some are born great some achieve greatness
the quality of mercy is not strained
et tu brutus
my kingdom for a horse
once more into the breach dear friends
we happy few we band of brothers
alas poor yorick i knew him well
something is rotten in denmark
the lady protests too much
brevity is the soul of wit
neither a borrower or lender be
to thine own self be true
parting is such sweet sorrow
exit pursued by a bear
we are such stuff as dreams are made of
o brave new world that has such people in it
uneasy lies the head that wears the crown
first thing we do lets kill all the lawyers
lord what fools these mortals be
cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war
beware the ides of march
tomorrow and tomorrow and tomorrow
a tale told by an idiot full of sound and fury
hamlet 3.1.56
sonnet 18
ham 3.1
